verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents multiple open-format export paths — Raw Event Export API returning JSONL (mixpanel-docs-7,9,18,31), CSV export from the UI (mixpanel-docs-25,30), Engage API for user profiles (mixpanel-docs-8), and Query API for aggregated data (mixpanel-docs-39,43) — enabling a user to pull out event, profile, and query data in standard formats. Community commentary even praises Mixpanel's export policy as 'great' when discussing data ownership (mixpanel-comm-13), corroborating that full data export works in practice. Missing for 10: no explicit statement of exporting *all* config/dashboard/schema metadata, and no independent bulk-export walkthrough beyond forum anecdote.
